response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years of experience, solid TypeScript/Node.js depth, and recent hands-on exposure to MCP servers and agentic-workflow tooling at re:cinq. However, the role requires 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions, and his AI/GenAI experience appears limited to roughly the past year. There is no demonstrated experience with vector databases, RAG architectures, LLM evaluation pipelines, or major-cloud AI system design beyond incidental AWS CDK use, making him a stretch for a staff-level forward-deployed GenAI role despite his overall engineering caliber.
strengths: Recent hands-on MCP and AI-agent infrastructure work, directly relevant to key technologies
15+ years of broad production engineering experience across web, backend, and high-throughput systems
Proven mentorship and knowledge-sharing track record (workshops, courses, conference talks)
concerns: Falls far short of the required 8+ years building AI-driven solutions (~1 year of GenAI work)
No evidence of vector databases, RAG architectures, or LLM evaluation/observability experience
Limited demonstrated cloud-platform AI system design and enterprise customer-facing delivery

key_factors.factor: Missing RAG/vector DB and eval pipeline expertise
